what: Among overlapping cells, the hovered cell widens to .32 of the row width and the panel inside rises to 1.22x of that width as height — neighboring panels on both sides drop to .83x, the rest to .70x height, and the remaining width is shared equally, shifting each cell in x (1.2s power4.out). When the pointer leaves the row, the first cell (default 0) widens again

options.large: Wide column width — share of the row width, default .3194 (460px at 1440)
options.tall: Wide cell panel height — multiple of the wide cell width, default 1.217
options.mid: Neighboring cell plate height multiplier, default .826
options.low: Height multiplier of the remaining cell panels, default .696
options.rest: Wide slot number when no hand is present, default 0
options.min: Not applied on screens narrower than this width (px), default 0 — one reference uses 1100
options.[data-fx-part=col]: Row right below the line — two or more
options.[data-fx-part=card]: (Optional) panel whose height changes within the cell

note: When the wide cell changes, is-focus is added to that cell and is-near to its neighbours (text hiding and number color are handled in the consuming css). Cells are stacked absolutely inside the row and the part sets the row height. On touch devices nothing is attached, so the consuming css applies as is — on phones it stays a horizontal drag list (the original uses embla)

from.where: index.html·service.html .es-work (original Work: wide cell 46rem, the rest (screen−3rem−46rem)/4, panel heights 56·38·32rem, 1.2s power4.out)
